warnings: T1 is a steel truss: on each slope a parallel-chord truss (depth 0.70 at section ข-ข, 0.35 at the eave support) meeting at the ridge, span 10.00 between the column lines, eave overhang 1.60 each side, 2.05 from the bearing level to ระดับสันโครงหลังคา, eave closure 1.20. The chord callouts read '⊐⊏-100 x 50 x 50 x 3.2' (double channel) and '⊔ 100 x 50 x 50 x 3.2'; the third number does not fit a plain channel and is kept verbatim — only d/b go into steel_section, the full list is in member_sections (an attribute sub-list, not drawing elements).

T2 (ขยายคานรับแปด้านสกัด) is the RC gable frame on grids 1 and 6: a sloped RC beam labelled R along both slopes (callouts 'เหล็ก 2-Ø 12 มม' top / 'เหล็ก 2-Ø 12 มม' bottom / 'ป-Ø6 มม @ 0.20' = the ขยายคาน R1 section) on columns at the 3.50 / 3.00 / 3.50 spacing, ending in the ครีบ ค.ส.ล. cantilevers. Its member specs live in the R1 and ครีบ entries of the view-4 section file; this entry records the frame and its printed callouts.

The connection callouts at the far right of the sheet (รูปตัด ข-ข, ขยาย 1, ขยาย 2) run under the title-block border and are partly hidden; the hidden parts were completed from the overall sheet image and the confidence is lowered.

Purlin spacing is printed as a range '@ 0.90-1.00 ม' → spacing_mm = 900 (the smallest) with variable_spacing (section 0.5). Unmarked members (purlin, connection details) take element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2).
